name: Speedtest Tracker

lifecycle.note: The shared recipe seeds ADMIN_EMAIL and a generated ADMIN_PASSWORD on first initialization. Its headless adapter verifies the saved administrator through the pinned Laravel model, creates one scoped Sanctum token through a checkpointed container command, saves it privately, and verifies token ownership and statistics access. Replay verifies the saved token without creating another. Fresh-image behavior, browser login, actual measurements, and restart persistence still require live acceptance.

security: Keep the web UI private, replace the documented default admin login on first start, and treat public IP, ISP, and location metadata as private operational data.
pitfalls: Frequent tests consume bandwidth and can distort application traffic or provider usage limits.

The pinned shared setup checks the seeded administrator inside the exact Laravel container and creates one scoped Sanctum token. If token creation commits but its one-time plaintext is lost before private storage, stop for explicit recovery rather than creating another token. Browser login UX and an actual measurement remain separate acceptance checks.
